description: Implementation of ThingsFieldExpressionFactory for handling field expressions in the Eclipse Ditto project, including methods for filtering, existence checks, and sorting based on property names with optional feature IDs.

classes.name: ThingsFieldExpressionFactoryImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of ThingsFieldExpressionFactory for creating field expressions based on property names, with support for custom and default field mappings.

methods.name: filterBy
methods.description: Creates a FilterFieldExpression based on the property name, handling feature IDs and property paths.

methods.name: existsBy
methods.description: Creates an ExistsFieldExpression for the given property name, considering feature IDs and property paths.

methods.name: sortBy
methods.description: Creates a SortFieldExpression based on the property name, supporting feature IDs and property paths.

methods.name: stripLeadingSlash
methods.description: Removes the leading slash from a property name if present.

methods.name: common
methods.description: Internal factory method for generating field expressions when filter and sort expressions are the same, based on attribute, definition, or mapped field names.
